Convert code to SVG/PNG/PDF via CLI or render in browsers/markdown files. ## Quick Start **Basic Diagram Structure:** ``` {diagram-type} {diagram-content} ``` **Common Diagram Types:** - `flowchart` - Process flows, decision trees - `sequenceDiagram` - Actor interactions, API flows - `classDiagram` - OOP structures, data models - `stateDiagram` - State machines, workflows - `erDiagram` - Database relationships - `gantt` - Project timelines - `journey` - User experience flows See `references/diagram-types.md` for all 24+ types with syntax. ## Creating Diagrams **Inline Markdown Code Blocks:** ````markdown ```mermaid flowchart TD A[Start] --> B{Decision} B -->|Yes| C[Action] B -->|No| D[End] ``` ```` **Configuration via Frontmatter:** ````markdown ```mermaid --- theme: dark --- flowchart LR A --> B ``` ```` **Comments:** Use `%% ` prefix for single-line comments. ## CLI Usage Convert `.mmd` files to images: ```bash # Installation npm install -g @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli # Basic conversion mmdc -i diagram.mmd -o diagram.svg # With theme and background mmdc -i input.mmd -o output.png -t dark -b transparent # Custom styling mmdc -i diagram.mmd --cssFile style.css -o output.svg ``` See `references/cli-usage.md` for Docker, batch processing, and advanced workflows. ## JavaScript Integration **HTML Embedding:** ```html 
  flowchart TD
    A[Client] --> B[Server]
``` See `references/integration.md` for Node.js API and advanced integration patterns. ## Configuration & Theming **Common Options:** - `theme`: "default", "dark", "forest", "neutral", "base" - `look`: "classic", "handDrawn" - `fontFamily`: Custom font specification - `securityLevel`: "strict", "loose", "antiscript" See `references/configuration.md` for complete config options, theming, and customization. ## Practical Patterns Load `references/examples.md` for: - Architecture diagrams - API documentation flows - Database schemas - Project timelines - State machines - User journey maps ## Resources - `references/diagram-types.md` - Syntax for all 24+ diagram types - `references/configuration.md` - Config, theming, accessibility - `references/cli-usage.md` - CLI commands and workflows - `references/integration.md` - JavaScript API and embedding - `references/examples.md` - Practical patterns and use cases "}

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Add a legend panel to the architecture diagram."""
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import sys

# Load the existing diagram
img = Image.open("/app/output/result.png")
w, h = img.size

# Legend height
LEG_H = 160
PADDING = 30
BG_COLOR = (10, 25, 41)  # #0a1929

# Create legend strip
legend = Image.new("RGB", (w, LEG_H), BG_COLOR)
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(legend)

# Title divider
draw.rectangle([(0, 0), (w, 2)], fill=(74, 144, 217))

# Try to get a monospace font
try:
    font_title = ImageFont.truetype("/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSansMono-Bold.ttf", 22)
    font_body  = ImageFont.truetype("/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSansMono.ttf", 18)
except:
    font_title = ImageFont.load_default()
    font_body  = font_title

title = "LEGEND"
draw.text((PADDING, 14), title, fill=(224, 232, 240), font=font_title)

items = [
    # (swatch_color, swatch_type, label)
    ((13,  79,  92), "rect",  "Access Tier Service (teal border)"),
    ((45,  27, 105), "rect",  "Business Tier Service — ⬡ = Istio sidecar (purple)"),
    ((76,  29,  18), "hex",   "Kafka MQ (message queue, orange)"),
    ((20,  83,  45), "cyl",   "Redis Cache (green)"),
    ((30,  58,  95), "cyl",   "Database (PostgreSQL / MongoDB / ES, blue)"),
    ((28,  25, 105), "rect",  "Order Service ★ = highest-fan-out hub (amber border)"),
    ((59,   7, 100), "rect",  "Istio Control Plane (magenta, dashed)"),
    ((28,  25, 105), "obs",   "Observability (Jaeger/Prometheus/EFK/Grafana, dashed border)"),
]

conn_items = [
    ((255, 255, 255), "solid",  "Synchronous call (solid arrow)"),
    ((255, 255, 255), "thick",  "Sync proxied via service mesh ⬡ (thick solid)"),
    ((255, 255, 255), "dashed", "Asynchronous / Kafka / DB replication (dashed)"),
    ((232, 121, 249), "dashed", "Istio xDS control channel (dashed, magenta)"),
]

# Draw node legend (left half)
x0 = PADDING
y0 = 46
col_w = w // 2 - PADDING
box_s = 18
row_h = 26

for i, (color, shape, label) in enumerate(items):
    x = x0 + (i % 4) * (col_w // 4)
    y = y0 + (i // 4) * row_h
    draw.rectangle([(x, y), (x + box_s, y + box_s)], fill=color, outline=(130, 180, 220), width=2)
    draw.text((x + box_s + 6, y + 2), label, fill=(200, 215, 230), font=font_body)

# Draw connection legend (right half)
x0r = w // 2 + PADDING
for j, (color, ltype, label) in enumerate(conn_items):
    x = x0r
    y = y0 + j * row_h
    lx1, lx2, ly = x, x + 36, y + box_s // 2
    if ltype == "solid":
        draw.line([(lx1, ly), (lx2, ly)], fill=color, width=2)
        draw.polygon([(lx2, ly-4), (lx2+8, ly), (lx2, ly+4)], fill=color)
    elif ltype == "thick":
        draw.line([(lx1, ly), (lx2, ly)], fill=(100, 180, 255), width=4)
        draw.polygon([(lx2, ly-5), (lx2+8, ly), (lx2, ly+5)], fill=(100, 180, 255))
    elif ltype == "dashed":
        for dx in range(0, lx2 - lx1, 8):
            draw.line([(lx1+dx, ly), (min(lx1+dx+5, lx2), ly)], fill=color, width=2)
        draw.polygon([(lx2, ly-4), (lx2+8, ly), (lx2, ly+4)], fill=color)
    draw.text((lx2 + 14, y + 2), label, fill=(200, 215, 230), font=font_body)

# Title bar at top

    ft_sub = ImageFont.truetype("/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSansMono.ttf", 18)
except:
    ft_big = ImageFont.load_default()
    ft_sub = ft_big

td.rectangle([(0, TITLE_H-3), (w, TITLE_H)], fill=(74, 144, 217))
main_title = "E-COMMERCE PLATFORM — 3-TIER MICROSERVICE ARCHITECTURE"
sub_title  = "12 application services  |  6 infrastructure components  |  5 observability/mesh nodes  |  44 edges"
td.text((PADDING, 8), main_title, fill=(224, 232, 240), font=ft_big)
td.text((PADDING, 36), sub_title, fill=(130, 180, 220), font=ft_sub)

# Stack: title + diagram + legend
